retrievalProfile.description: A surrealist photomontage style that juxtaposes disparate elements like animals, interior rooms, and abstract textures within a white-bordered frame.
triggerTerms: juxtaposed animal and human figures in a room
excludeWhen: a clean minimalist photograph is requested
a single-subject portrait without background elements is needed

recipe.visualDefinition: A complex visual composition featuring a central interior room scene framed by textured, blue-toned landscape fragments, all contained within a thick white square border. The foreground features a child and a kangaroo in a relaxed, domestic setting, creating a dreamlike narrative through scale and context shifts.
coreVisualRelationships: Interior room nested within abstract landscape textures
Foreground figures overlapping the central room scene
Textured blue elements framing the top and sides of the central image
Small-scale typography centered in the top and bottom white margins
coreInvariants: Thick white outer border framing the entire square composition
Juxtaposition of interior and exterior environments
Low-contrast, slightly desaturated color palette with blue dominance

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: The child and kangaroo occupy the lower foreground at a large scale, while the interior room provides a mid-ground depth.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The central interior room with its symmetrical windows acts as the structural anchor.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: The eye moves from the large foreground figures up into the interior room and then outward to the textured blue framing elements.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: The thick white border provides significant negative space that isolates the complex collage.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Muted blue and grey tones in the landscape and interior textures.
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Warm skin tones and pinkish-red clothing on the child.
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Small pops of red in the typography and interior details.
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: Low saturation overall with a matte, printed texture appearance.
paletteRestrictions: Maintain a desaturated, vintage print feel

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Single font family used for both top and bottom text for consistency.

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the geometric, monolinear sans-serif look.
Provides the necessary geometric lowercase forms.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a square surrealist collage featuring a central interior room with windows, a child and a kangaroo in the foreground, and textured blue landscape elements framing the top. Surround the entire image with a thick white border.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add small, lowercase geometric sans-serif text in dark red, centered in the top and bottom white margins with wide letter spacing.

verificationChecks: Is the text lowercase and red?
Is there a thick white border around the collage?
Are the foreground figures a child and a kangaroo?
Is the tracking wide on the typography?

mustRedesign: Do not replicate the exact faces of the individuals
postGenerationChecks: Check for the presence of the white border
Verify the text is lowercase and centered
Ensure the collage elements overlap correctly
Confirm the color palette is muted and cohesive
recipe.reuseFormula: Surrealist Collage [Subject A] + [Subject B] in [Environment] framed by [Texture] with [Color] lowercase sans-serif typography in a white border.
